Players Committee card image of [[Boba Fett's Blaster Rifle (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on your non-[maintenance] bounty hunter. If on Boba Fett, once per game, during your move phase, may use 2 Force to relocate him (with any captive he is escorting) to a [Jabba's Palace] site. May target a character or vehicle for free. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +2 > defense value.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Dark/large/bobafettsblasterrifle.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
